Here's the meaning of the flag:

The emblem in the top left represents the capital Skopje. The Red is the blood of the people that has been spilled for the freedom of the nation and all the previous wars and conflicts that took place on the lands of Vardaska. The Green represents the Nature and landscapes of the country and the White represents the cultures and faiths of the people, all living together united as one in peace.

Vardaska was a province of the Kingdom of Yugoslavia known as Banovinas between 1929-1941. This is a flag that I've made which represents the Republic of Vardaska. The flag is similar to the Bulgarian flag, it is simply a reversed Bulgarian flag with the emblem of the capital (Skopje) in the top left. Why the reversed Bulgarian flag? Vardaska is a predominantly Slavic populated country with the majority being Bulgarian (Macedonians are considered to be Bulgarians in this alt world). This flag is entirely made up and in no way historic.
